summary: Tested Mobile Repair Shop Management App MVP (backend + frontend). Backend: 7/7 pytest cases passed - GET /api/jobs returns array, GET /api/config returns sheet_connected=false (expected, MongoDB fallback), POST /api/jobs creates 15-field job with auto-calc Profit/Share (cost=1200, amount=3000, %=30 -> Profit=1800, Share=540; %=40 -> Share=600), Status=Pending, IST received_date/time set, completed empty. POST /api/jobs/update sets Status=Completed and stamps completed_date/time. Persistence verified via add->GET. Frontend: app loads at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL with Repair Desk header, KPIs, search, tabs, FAB, LOCAL MODE banner. Add Job dialog shows live preview Profit=₹1,800 / Share=₹540. After save, dialog closes, job appears within ~2s with exact Name (not 'Customer'), ₹ INR formatting correct. Search by name/phone/model filters list. Tabs filter All/Pending/Completed. Mark as Completed moves job to Completed tab with green badge and populates Done: date/time.

design_issues.screen: FAB / Mark as Completed buttons (bottom-right corner)
issues: The 'Made with Emergent' badge sits over the bottom-right area and can intercept Playwright clicks on the FAB on some viewports. Real user clicks still work because the badge is small; however, using z-index/margin to keep the FAB clear would improve UX and testability.
Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for DialogContent. Add a <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby for a11y compliance (non-blocking).

action_items: Optional: add <DialogDescription> in AddJobDialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
Optional: increase FAB bottom margin or z-index so the Emergent badge does not visually overlap it on small viewports.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: Profit field is not rounded (e.g. floats like 1799.99 could appear). Rounding Profit = round(amount-cost, 2) would mirror Share rounding.
server.py: percentage default replacement `to_num(...) or 30` will treat valid 0% as 30%. Acceptable since UI restricts to 30/40 but worth a guard.
server.py: /api/jobs/update does not return 404 if ID is missing in MongoDB; update_one silently no-ops. Consider checking matched_count and returning 404.
RepairShop.jsx: list sort uses string concat for date+time; works given fixed ISO format but using actual timestamps would be more robust.
seed_data_creation: Several TEST_-prefixed jobs were created in MongoDB during pytest runs (test_database.jobs). Not cleaned up - main agent may want to drop the collection if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses MongoDB fallback because GOOGLE_SHEET_WEBAPP_URL is empty - this is intentional. Tests in /app/backend/tests/test_repair_shop.py cover the 15-field schema, calculations, and complete flow. Frontend automation must use JS click (page.evaluate) for FAB and per-job complete buttons because the Emergent badge overlay can intercept Playwright clicks at 1280x900.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Initial Playwright fab click issue was an automation overlay artifact (Made-with-Emergent badge), not an app bug; resolved by triggering DOM .click() directly.
